title: LED isn't that great
text: LED isn't that great. I got a whole bunch of these and was super excited. I bought similar (non LED) ones a couple of years back and they are my favorite decoration. Those are very flickery and very uncomfortable to look at, I'm unsure of what to do, but I might as well send all 8 back. :-( I wish they would simply be like the old style they had years ago, I think the LEDs are either of low quality (others I have don't flicker) or something must be wrong. I would not buy again
